ui.Bring your discharge notes if availab: Weta akwụkwọ ntọhapụ ụlọ ọgwụ ma ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ya, ndepụta ọgwụ na ajụjụ gbasara mgbaàmà, inye nwa nri, mgbake na nleta ọzọ.
ui.Discuss healing, feeding, sleep, bloo: Kwurịta mgbake, inye nwa nri, ụra, nyocha ọbara mgbali ebe achọrọ, ahụike uche na nleta na-aga n'ihu. Mgbake nwere ike ịga n'ihu karịa izu isii.
ui.Educational content requires clinical: Ọdịnaya mmụta chọrọ nyocha ndị ọkachamara ahụike tupu nnwale n'ụwa n'ezie.
